# Simple Pet Target

[![Build](https://github.com/joseph3114/SimplePetTarget/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/joseph3114/SimplePetTarget/actions/workflows/build.yml) [![Lint](https://github.com/joseph3114/SimplePetTarget/actions/workflows/lint.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/joseph3114/SimplePetTarget/actions/workflows/lint.yml) [![Tests](https://github.com/joseph3114/SimplePetTarget/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/joseph3114/SimplePetTarget/actions/workflows/tests.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/joseph3114/SimplePetTarget)](https://github.com/joseph3114/SimplePetTarget/releases/latest) [![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/v/1794445?label=CurseForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/simple-pet-target)

A World of Warcraft Forever addon that adds a **Pet Target Frame**: a small frame showing whatever your pet is targeting. It looks and behaves like Blizzard's own Target of Target frame.

## Features

- Same design as the default Target of Target frame: round portrait, name, health bar and power bar
- Health and power numbers that follow Blizzard's Status Text option (Numeric, Percentage or Both), or show while you point at the frame when that option is None, like the Pet Frame
- Up to 4 debuffs with cooldown swipes and dispel-type borders, in combat too: they're shown through Blizzard's secure aura display, since the game doesn't let addons read auras in combat. Hover a debuff for its tooltip
- Shows DEAD or UNCONSCIOUS like the default frame
- Left-click to target your pet's target; click-casting and pings work on it too
- Appears automatically whenever your pet has a target, including in combat
- Follows Blizzard's class-icon portrait options, and the `showDispelDebuffs` console variable the way Target of Target does (on friendly targets, only debuffs you can dispel)

## Turning it on or off

**Options › AddOns › Simple Pet Target › Show Pet Target Frame** turns the frame on or off, like Blizzard's Target of Target option.

## Edit Mode

Open Edit Mode and the **Pet Target Frame** shows up with the rest of your frames. A small **Simple Pet Target** panel next to the HUD Edit Mode window has a **Pet Target Frame** checkbox that works like Blizzard's Pet Frame checkbox: uncheck it to leave the frame out of Edit Mode. It's greyed out while the frame is turned off in Options.

Click the frame to open its options:

- **Attach to Pet Frame** (on by default): sits next to your Pet Frame and follows its position and size, like Target of Target does with the Target frame
- **Frame Size**: 100% to 200%, used when the frame isn't attached

When it isn't attached, drag it anywhere. Position, Attach to Pet Frame and Frame Size are saved per Edit Mode layout; the two on/off checkboxes apply to all layouts.

## Libraries

- [LibEditMode](https://github.com/p3lim-wow/LibEditMode) by p3lim, for the Edit Mode integration. It is included unmodified, from commit `adfa353` (the first with the WoW Forever fix for its position panel), under its own license in `Libs/LibEditMode/LICENSE.txt`.

## Development

The repository folder is the addon folder. To test changes in game, link it into the AddOns folder and `/reload` after each change, for example from PowerShell:

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "D:\WoW\World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\SimplePetTarget" -Target "C:\Users\josep\claude\SimplePetTarget"
```

Releases come from version tags (`vX.Y.Z`; a tag containing `beta` is a beta). CurseForge's automatic packaging builds and publishes the CurseForge file, and the **Release** workflow publishes the same zip as a [GitHub release](https://github.com/joseph3114/SimplePetTarget/releases), with notes from the commit messages since the previous tag. `.pkgmeta` leaves the `assets` folder (logos, the CurseForge description image and the scripts that draw them), the tests, the GitHub workflows, `.luacheckrc`, `CLAUDE.md` and this README out of the package.

### Checks

GitHub Actions runs three checks on every push and pull request, and a fourth workflow on version tags:

- **Build** packages the addon with the same packager CurseForge uses, without uploading it, and checks what went into the zip. The zip is attached to the run.
- **Lint** runs [luacheck](https://github.com/lunarmodules/luacheck) on the addon's code (`.luacheckrc` lists the game API it uses) and checks the XML is well-formed.
- **Tests** loads the addon and LibEditMode, in TOC order, into a stand-in for the game (`tests/wowmock.lua`) and plays through logging in, pet targets, combat, the Options checkbox, Edit Mode and debuffs. The stand-in hides values the way the client does (secret values) and refuses protected changes in combat, so the tests catch code that would break in game. Each run's summary page lists every test.
- **Release** runs on each version tag: it packages the addon the same way, without uploading it to CurseForge, and publishes the zip as a GitHub release.

To run the tests yourself, with Lua 5.1 or LuaJIT:

```sh
lua tests/run.lua
```

Without Lua installed, `python tests/lupa_run.py` runs them with the LuaJIT in the [lupa](https://pypi.org/project/lupa/) package. Name spec files to run only those, for example `lua tests/run.lua 05_debuffs`.

## License

MIT for the addon's own code; see `LICENSE`. LibEditMode keeps its own license.

releases.name: Simple Pet Target v1.1.1
releases.notes:
### Keep the frame's settings in new Edit Mode layouts

- A new account-wide Edit Mode layout now keeps the Pet Target Frame's position, Attach to Pet Frame and Frame Size from the layout it was copied from. Before, it went back to the defaults when a character-specific layout existed.
- The frame now follows a new layout right away when that layout takes the active layout's place in the list.
- Damaged or incomplete saved settings are repaired when the addon loads, instead of leaving the frame unplaced.
- README: mention the health and power numbers, and describe the dispellable debuffs behaviour accurately.
- Tests: cover creating, copying, renaming and deleting layouts, damaged settings, power bar textures and sparks, and Edit Mode without a pet. The game stand-in now has the client's three preset layouts and checks more of what the client checks.

### Add the CurseForge description demo image and the script that builds it

### CI: upload the Build zip from the hidden .release folder

### CI: move to Node 24 action versions and pin Ubuntu 24.04

### README: describe the Release workflow and everything .pkgmeta leaves out

### README: add a latest release badge

### Publish a GitHub release with the packaged zip for every version tag

The Release workflow packages without uploading to CurseForge, which keeps building
from its own webhook, and writes the notes from the commit messages since the previous
tag. A release written by hand only gets the zip attached.

### Add CLAUDE.md with the project's gotchas, checks and release steps

Kept out of the CurseForge package (.pkgmeta), checked by the package test and the
Build workflow.

### CI: install Lua and luacheck from Ubuntu packages; lint only this repository's code

### Add Build, Lint and Tests checks on GitHub Actions

Build packages the addon with the BigWigs packager (no upload) and checks the zip.
Lint runs luacheck and checks the XML. Tests loads the addon and LibEditMode into a
stand-in for the game with secret values and combat rules, and runs 48 tests
covering visibility, bars, debuffs and Edit Mode. README gets badges and a section
on the checks; .pkgmeta leaves the new files out of the package.

Also on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/simple-pet-target).

releases.name: Simple Pet Target v1.1.0
releases.notes:
- Debuffs on your pet's target now show and update **in combat** too. They're drawn by Blizzard's secure aura display, because the game doesn't let addons read auras in combat.
- Same 2x2 grid, dispel-type borders and cooldown swipes as before; hover a debuff for its tooltip.
- Edit Mode shows Blizzard's sample debuffs, like Target of Target.

Also on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/simple-pet-target).

releases.name: Simple Pet Target v1.0.0
releases.notes:
The first full release.

- **Show Pet Target Frame** moved to Options › AddOns › Simple Pet Target, like Blizzard's Target of Target option. A change made in combat takes effect when combat ends.
- A new **Pet Target Frame** checkbox, in a small panel beside the HUD Edit Mode window, decides whether Edit Mode shows the frame, like Blizzard's Pet Frame checkbox. It checks itself for the session when the frame is already showing, and the panel moves to whichever side has room.
- The frame's own Edit Mode options are now just Attach to Pet Frame and Frame Size, still saved per layout.
- Fixed "execution tainted by SimplePetTarget" errors from the Cooldown Manager and Damage Meter after using Edit Mode.
- Units without power no longer show 0 as their power text.
- The frame's settings dialog now closes when Edit Mode stops showing the frame.

Also on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/simple-pet-target).
